page_title: STU 4-0 FRE | Stuttgart v Freiburg 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
89' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes.
86' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 12:4.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' Jacob Bruun Larsen (VfB Stuttgart) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
81' Substitution. Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) has come on for Ameen Al Dakhil.
80' 4 - 0 Goal! Chris Fuhrich passes the ball to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Florian Muller couldn't do anything about it. 4:0.
76' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) replaces Junior Adamu.
76' That will be all from Merlin Rohl who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
75' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Freiburg.
74' Stuttgart enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
73' Stuttgart control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
69' Here is a change. Ermedin Demirovic is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).
69' Nick Woltemade will be replaced by Yannik Keitel (VfB Stuttgart).
66' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alexander Nubel.
62' Freiburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
61' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Jamie Leweling and he is replaced by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
61' The substitution is prepared. Jacob Bruun Larsen (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Enzo Millot.
60' Felix Zwayer interrupts the game. One of the players from Freiburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Stuttgart earn a free kick.
59' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Christian Gunter will be replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
59' Vincenzo Grifo goes off the pitch and Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) comes on.
57' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' The main referee, Felix Zwayer, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is given a yellow card for dissent.
53' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
51' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
50' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) gets booked for the first time in this match.
45+5' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45+5' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Florian Muller no chance!
45+4' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) is going to take the penalty!
45+4' Felix Zwayer couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) and blew his whistle. Stuttgart are about to take a penalty!
45+3' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45+3' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Now Stuttgart have a corner.
45+1' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Florian Muller was alert and made a comfortable save.
45+1' The resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) comes to nothing.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Stuttgart as they win a corner.
44' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
43' A player from Freiburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

42' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Stuttgart are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
40' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Freiburg will have an opportunity.
32' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Stuttgart players look gutted.
31' Referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand. Let’s see what happens!
29' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
27' The game is pretty dull as Freiburg are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
26' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
25' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) picks up an injury.
20' Problems for Julian Schuster as Matthias Ginter is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) replaces him.

17' 2 - 0 Goal! Angelo Stiller clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner. Florian Muller had no chance of stopping that. 2:0.
17' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Stuttgart, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Stuttgart force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
16' Stuttgart have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
15' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
15' Great teamplay by Stuttgart as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Freiburg get a free kick.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
11' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) has tested the patience of referee Felix Zwayer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
10' The Stuttgart players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) has a goal ruled out for offside!
2' 1 - 0 Angelo Stiller takes the corner and Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
2' The linesman makes the right call and Stuttgart will have a corner.

2' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Stuttgart will kick-off.
Felix Zwayer is the one to supervise the game today.
